registryEntry.label: Add NSG Rules — CES Outbound 443 to Named Service Tags (SB-2)
registryEntry.get_command: $r = @(Get-AzNetworkSecurityGroup -ResourceGroupName '{resourceGroup}' -Name 'nsg-workload-cmmc' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty SecurityRules | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'CES-Out-443-*' -and $_.Name -ne 'CES-Out-443-M365' -and $_.Access -eq 'Allow' -and $_.Direction -eq 'Outbound' -and (@($_.DestinationPortRange) -contains '443') }); if ($r.Count -ge 7) { [pscustomobject]@{ Rules = @($r | Select-Object Name,Priority,Access,Direction,DestinationAddressPrefix,DestinationPortRange) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 }
registryEntry.set_command: $nsg = Get-AzNetworkSecurityGroup -ResourceGroupName '{resourceGroup}' -Name 'nsg-workload-cmmc'; $p = 200; foreach ($t in @('AzureActiveDirectory','AzureResourceManager','AzureKeyVault','Storage','GuestAndHybridManagement','AzureUpdateDelivery','AzureFrontDoor.FirstParty')) { $n = 'CES-Out-443-' + ($t -replace '\.','-'); if (-not ($nsg.SecurityRules | Where-Object Name -eq $n)) { $null = Add-AzNetworkSecurityRuleConfig -NetworkSecurityGroup $nsg -Name $n -Description 'SB-2 CES outbound allow (COST-GATE-SPEC 4.3)' -Protocol 'Tcp' -SourcePortRange '*' -DestinationPortRange '443' -SourceAddressPrefix 'VirtualNetwork' -DestinationAddressPrefix $t -Access 'Allow' -Priority $p -Direction 'Outbound' }; $p++ }; $nsg | Set-AzNetworkSecurityGroup | Out-Null; Write-Output 'SB-2 service-tag allow rules present'
evidence_commands: $r = @(Get-AzNetworkSecurityGroup -ResourceGroupName '{resourceGroup}' -Name 'nsg-workload-cmmc' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty SecurityRules | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'CES-Out-443-*' -and $_.Name -ne 'CES-Out-443-M365' -and $_.Access -eq 'Allow' -and $_.Direction -eq 'Outbound' }); if ($r.Count -ge 7) { $r | Select-Object Name,Priority,Access,Direction,DestinationAddressPrefix,DestinationPortRange | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 }
